fresh_leads.qualification_text: Software Engineer, New Grad New York, NY At Secureframe https://secureframe.com/, we are not just a company; we are at the forefront of revolutionizing cybersecurity compliance. Recognized as one of the industry's most innovative and trusted providers, Secureframe has consistently received accolades for our advanced technology solutions and commitment to excellence. With a robust portfolio of products that safeguard thousands of businesses worldwide, we have been featured in major publications such as Forbes' next billion dollar startups https://www.forbes.com/sites/amyfeldman/2022/08/16/next-billion-dollar-startups-2022/, TechCrunch, and The Wall Street Journal for our transformative impact on the way companies achieve and maintain compliance standards. As we continue to grow, our mission remains clear: to provide seamless, secure solutions that enable businesses to focus on what they do best. Joining Secureframe means becoming part of a team dedicated to professional excellence and continuous learning in an environment that values creativity and forward-thinking. Secureframe is backed by top VCs including Kleiner Perkins, Accomplice, Gradient Ventures (Google's AI Fund), BoxGroup, Village Global, and many more. About the role We're an impactful and highly collaborative team aiming to bring excellence to the world of security and compliance. Every member of the team is an owner, with significant responsibility and the opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the team and defining our culture. This role is built for engineers early in their careers, whether you're about to finish your degree or you're a year into your first job. You'll ship real features from the start and learn alongside senior engineers who care about helping you grow. This role is for candidates who can start full time in 2027, with start dates available from January through August. This is a hybrid position based in New York City. Secureframe highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Secureframe office), Secureframe considers working in the office, approximately 30% of the time under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

fresh_leads.qualification_text: What We're Looking For Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, graduating in Spring 2027 (April to June 2027). By getting out of our usual environment and doing out-of-the-ordinary things together, we foster creativity and broaden our imaginations to accomplish new challenges. fresh_leads.qualification_text: Robotics Software Engineer Intern, Autonomy [Automation] Austin, TX JOIN CONTORO ROBOTICS – REVOLUTIONIZING WAREHOUSE AUTOMATION WITH CUTTING-EDGE ROBOTICS At Contoro Robotics, we're on a mission to solve labor challenges through advanced robotic solutions. Headquartered in Austin, TX, our fast-growing startup is transforming the supply chain industry with our flagship warehouse automation technology. Our team is made up of top-tier experts in robotics, AI, and logistics, working together to push the boundaries of automation. We're looking for talented and ambitious individuals to join us on this journey—helping shape the future of robotics while growing alongside a world-class team. If you're passionate about innovation, problem-solving, and making a real-world impact, we want to hear from you! Contoro · Internship · Austin, TX About Contoro Robotics is an Austin based startup focused on warehouse automation. We design a state-of-the-art autonomous truck unloading system capable of lifting boxes over 60 lbs. As an Autonomy Software Intern, you'll join the team that builds the motion planning and autonomous behavior software running on our fleet of unloading robots. You'll help keep that software reliable and easy to build on: you'll investigate issues, discuss improvements, implement well-scope fixes and strengthen the tools and processes the team uses every day. You'll work closely with senior autonomy engineers who will review your code and mentor you. This is a hands-on software role, and the code you write will run on real robots in real customer environments. In this role, you will: - Investigate issues reported from robots in the field and in our test facility, using logs, telemetry, and recorded data to narrow down root causes - Implement well-scoped fixes and improvements in Python and C++, and take them through code review to deployment - Help improve the reliability, coverage, and organization of the team's automated testing - Contribute to the internal developer tools that help engineers understand and debug robot behavior - Keep documentation, runbooks, and overall code health up to date as the codebase evolves - Work with autonomy, perception, hardware, and test engineers to reproduce problems and verify fixes on real robots - Share findings clearly in written updates and team discussions You might thrive in this role if you: - Are pursuing a degree in computer science, robotics, mechanical or electrical engineering, or a related field, with a strong software focus - Write clean, readable code in Python and/or C++ - Are comfortable with the Linux command line and Git-based workflows (branches, pull requests, code review) - Enjoy debugging: reading unfamiliar code and logs until you understand what is really happening - Can clearly communicate what you found, what you changed, and why - Have exposure to ROS, motion planning, or robotic systems - Have experience writing automated tests or working with CI pipelines and Docker - Can work on-site at Contoro's office in Austin, TX for the duration of the internship - Are available throughout two continuous terms (e.g., Spring + Summer or Summer + Fall)
